functionDeclarations.name: ask_question
functionDeclarations.description: Ask the user one or more multiple-choice questions, e.g. to clarify requirements, and wait for the answers. Don't use it for trivial yes/no questions; ask those in plain text.

is_multi_select.description: Whether the user can select several options.

options.description: Answers to choose from, unnumbered and without an 'Other' option; the UI adds both. Put a recommended answer first, prefixed with '(Recommended)'.

question.description: The question, without 'select all that apply' or similar; the UI adds that.
